row.notes: AdvanceData timer restart (this, day:i16, notificationHolder, withFlag). Counts notifications for that day (holder+0xa0..+0xa8, each vcall +0x20 returns day); delay = cfg[*this]+4 (no notification) / +8 / +0xc (notification, flag); stamps QPC into this[2] (and this[3] if set), stores delay float at this+0x30; logs 'Timer restarted with delay' / 'New notification'. Called by AdvanceOneDay, both OnTimer state machines and ClearStopping. Addon: shorten Team HQ day-advance delays by patching the delay config floats. | #587: L2 by lead-authorised promotion for lane owner career-re (independent agree V3080)
